introCard.heading: Why choose Clinique du VR?
introCard.body: Specialized and attentive service for RV modification, Van Life conversion, solar and lithium systems, maintenance and repair. Canada-wide modification, Van Life and solar projects can be framed remotely, then planned for workshop work in Gatineau depending on the assignment, timeline and vehicle logistics.

partsStore.heading: RV Parts and Accessories Store
partsStore.body: Visit us for a selection of parts and accessories for RV maintenance, repairs, and upgrades, including solar products. Our team can also help you identify the right product for your vehicle and check its availability.

seoSections.heading: RV modification, Van Life and solar projects in Canada
seoSections.body: Clinique du VR supports owners of RVs, travel trailers, caravans and vans with modification, Van Life conversion, solar and lithium autonomy, Victron Energy and Bluetti products, pre-purchase inspection, preventive maintenance, water leak repair, roof work and restoration. The Gatineau workshop serves nearby regions and can frame selected modification, Van Life and solar projects for clients across Canada.

seoSections.heading: A useful approach before any work begins
seoSections.body: When a vehicle needs more autonomy, a custom interior, Van Life equipment, solar and lithium upgrades, or repair after wear or water intrusion, the first step is to clarify the vehicle's actual condition, province, travel plan and logistics. We then help you choose the most useful next step.
